title: PC-CROP production runtime exact-SHA handoff immune to protected-value masking
acceptance: the owner-only issue 3072 command binds every downstream job directly to the GitHub event SHA and rechecks that SHA against current main before any REG.RU mutation
the exact SHA is never transported through a job output that GitHub may drop when a short protected value is a substring of the commit SHA
missing, stale or drifting event SHA fails closed before SSH and before production mutation
the existing protected runtime provision, pinned SSH host identity, exact image publication, exact release and post-release readiness boundaries remain unchanged
no credential, PII, reviewer identity, password, TOTP or raw protected environment value is emitted
production hosting remains the existing REG.RU contour and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB
